name: Back To Wellness Chiropractic
what_they_do: Wellness center at 525 Milltown Rd, Suite 201 offering chiropractic care (Dr. Lucien Eid) alongside acupuncture, massage therapy and a same-address physical therapy clinic. Takes personal-injury cases and most health insurance, and publishes a monthly newsletter plus wellness articles. Site also lists a satellite 'Spine & Wellness Center' office in Zalka, Lebanon.
customers: Local North Brunswick residents with back/neck pain, headaches and injury recovery, personal-injury claimants, insured patients; plus a second client base in Lebanon through the satellite office.

size_signals.signal: Multiple disciplines under one roof (chiropractic, acupuncture, massage) and a sister 'Back to Wellness Physical Therapy' listing at the same address
Second location listed in Zalka, Lebanon with local phone numbers
Ratings of 4.9 (chiropractic) and 5.0 (physical therapy) on Google for the same address

listing.reviews: count not displayed in the limited logged-out Maps view

website_review.primary_cta: 'Request Appointment' link in the top bar plus a phone number repeated in body copy; no booking calendar
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: No online booking. The site relies on a phone number (732-545-3300) and an email/contact path; the request-appointment URL I tried returned 404, so I could not verify a working form.
website_review.trust_signals: Doctor bio, testimonials page, newsletter archive with an October 2026 article, insurance and personal-injury acceptance, member wellness area, multi-service team
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Template chiropractic site with no structured data; several nav URLs I tried returned 404 (contact-us.html, appointment-request.html), suggesting dead links or renamed pages; the live site returned HTTP 403 to my Chrome browser while a plain fetch succeeded
website_review.search_basics: Title names chiropractor + North Brunswick, service and article pages exist, monthly newsletter keeps content fresh; no JSON-LD, and the 403 response may stop crawlers that render like a browser
top_issues: Home page returned '403 Unauthorized' to a real Chrome browser (both / and /index.html)
No schema.org markup at all (0 JSON-LD scripts)
No online scheduling, and some internal links 404

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: robots.txt is unusually explicit and permissive - GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot and Google-Extended are all Allow: / - but the site itself answered my Chrome session with HTTP 403 Unauthorized, so any crawler that looks like a browser may be shut out (counter-evidence: a plain HTTP fetch returned the full page, so filtering is UA/IP based - inference). Answerable: address, phone, doctor name and service descriptions are text, but there is no JSON-LD (0 nodes), hours are not stated on the home page and no prices are published. Bookable: phone-plus-email only; the contact and appointment-request URLs I tried both returned 404.

operations_signals.signal: Three service lines (chiro, acupuncture, massage) plus a physical therapy clinic share one phone number and one contact path - inference: staff manually sort requests across providers
Personal-injury cases are a stated focus, which normally means document collection, lien paperwork and progress reporting
Monthly newsletter and article archive exist and are current (October 2026), so a content pipeline is already in place to feed automated follow-up emails

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the site's availability to browsers and add LocalBusiness/Chiropractor schema with hours and both locations - being 403 to a Chrome user-agent is a direct revenue and crawlability risk
top_opportunities.evidence: Both / and /index.html returned HTTP 403 Unauthorized in the browser while a plain HTTP request succeeded; JSON-LD count is 0

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add online scheduling that routes by provider (chiropractor, acupuncturist, massage therapist, PT) with intake questions for personal-injury cases, replacing the phone-only booking
top_opportunities.evidence: Site instructs visitors to 'call 732-545-3300' or email; no calendar anywhere and the appointment-request URL 404s

top_opportunities.opportunity: Repair dead internal links (contact-us.html, appointment-request.html 404) and put a click-to-call bar plus reviews on the mobile layout
top_opportunities.evidence: Two internal URLs returned HTTP 404 from the origin server

scores.reasons: Gap: multi-service practice on a template site with a 403 to browsers, no schema, no booking and some 404s. Pay: several providers and a physical-therapy arm plus a second country office, but the practice is small and consumer-ticket. Ease: schema and link fixes are quick; booking across four provider types is a bigger job. Evidence: browser was blocked (403), so the site review rests on a text fetch plus Maps - weakest evidence in this batch.
